golden tee plug and play - plays six cla.name: Golden Tee Plug and Play - Plays Six Classic Arcade Games
golden tee plug and play - plays six cla.description: The Golden Tee Plug and Play from New Wave Toys brings a slice of the arcade home, packing six classic arcade games into a single, ready-to-play unit built around authentic hardware. The lineup includes Golden Tee Golf along with five additional classic arcade titles licensed by Incredible Technologies, giving players a genuine mix of well-known arcade experiences rather than a single game in isolation. Built from heavy-duty wood construction, the unit takes the form of a full-sized arcade stick complete with real T-molding, and it measures 5.2 inches high, 15.25 inches wide, and 10.2 inches deep, giving it a sturdy, arcade-accurate presence without requiring a full-scale cabinet. Control comes from a 3-inch GRS arcade trak-ball paired with authentic, high-quality arcade buttons, delivering the same kind of real arcade-style control that fans of Golden Tee and similar titles expect from the original machines. Setup is kept simple through HDMI plug and play functionality, which connects directly to your TV via HDMI for a cable-free setup that gets you into gameplay immediately without extra wiring or console requirements. Wireless 2.4GHz technology, powered by a built-in rechargeable battery, keeps the unit cable-free during play as well, so you are not tethered to your television while golfing or working through the other included titles. The unit is backed by a 100-day New Wave factory warranty, giving buyers some assurance around the hardware's construction and craftsmanship. With six classic games, authentic wood and trak-ball construction, simple HDMI hookup, and cable-free wireless play, the Golden Tee Plug and Play offers a compact way to bring genuine arcade nostalgia into any living room or game room setup.
